item.title: People of Purpose: How Maninder Singh Is Reimagining Careers and Institutions for Social Change Through JobShob Nest
item.description: Maninder Singh is the founder of Jobshob Nest and he is also the co-founder of Vrikshai Collective Foundation.

item.title: Mumbai Horror: 4-Year-Old Allegedly Sexually Assaulted in School Van in Badlapur, Driver Arrested
item.description: A school van driver has been arrested under POCSO after a four-year-old girl in Badlapur alleged sexual abuse during her journey home.

item.title: Punjab Launches ₹10 Lakh Cashless Healthcare for Every Family, Removes All Income and Eligibility Barriers
item.description: Punjab’s new Mukhyamantri Sehat Yojana removes income and eligibility barriers to make quality healthcare accessible to every resident through cashless treatment across public and private hospitals.

item.title: J&K: Udhampur Police Rescue 12 People Including Women and Children Stranded in Basantgarh Snowstorm
item.description: Police personnel trekked several kilometres through treacherous weather conditions to save stranded families, who were provided food, shelter, and medical assistance following their rescue.

item.title: Top 10 Best Demat Account Providers in India (2026)
item.description: A comprehensive guide to choosing the right demat provider among India's top 10, tailored to your investing style and hidden costs.

item.title: Seven Killed, 25 Injured in Suicide Blast at Wedding Ceremony in Pakistan’s Dera Ismail Khan
item.description: A reported suicide bombing kills seven at a Pakistan wedding ceremony targeting, leaving several injured.

item.title: 5-Year-Old Detained by ICE in Minnesota, Sparking Outrage Over US Immigration Practices
item.description: The detention of a five-year-old asylum-seeking child during a Minnesota immigration arrest has ignited outrage, political sparring and renewed scrutiny of how US enforcement treats vulnerable families.

item.title: Goons Attack Wedding Procession in UP’s Greater Noida, Ten Family Members Critically Injured: Reports
item.description: Over 40 armed men attacked a Greater Noida wedding procession on Friday, leaving ten guests critically injured.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Home Minister Felicitates Woman Constable for Managing Traffic While Holding Infant
item.description: An off-duty woman constable in Andhra Pradesh was honoured after she managed traffic with her infant in her arms to ensure an ambulance passed unhindered.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh Shocker: 24-Year-Old NEET Aspirant Allegedly Amputates Own Foot in Jaunpur to Claim PwD Quota, Probe On
item.description: A 24-year-old NEET aspirant in Uttar Pradesh allegedly mutilated his own foot to falsely claim the PwD quota, sparking debate on exam pressure, mental health, and misuse of affirmative action.
